mechanism_narrative: A 2% YoY increase in Real GDP signals strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances following 2%+ YoY GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, it indicates a tightening monetary cycle, increasing borrowing costs and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns remain positive in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth accelerates by 1% MoM, it signals a labor market boom, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 60% of instances meeting the joint trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A 5% MoM increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) indicates a supply chain rebound, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) following a 5%+ MoM INDPRO increase.

mechanism_narrative: Always, the S&P 500 exhibits a slight positive drift over any 60 trading day period due to underlying economic growth trends.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of this mechanism remains below 0.01 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the difference between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds 2%, it signals a monetary policy mistake, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 4.5% without a corresponding increase in PAYEMS signals a labor market imbalance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of instances meeting the joint trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS exceeding $400,000 signals increased consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) when RSAFS is above $400,000.
